name: Amaenbo ~Sei o Osaekirenai Boku to Mushou no Oyako~
original_name: あまえんぼ ~性を抑えきれない僕と無償の親子~
source:
Summer break has begun, and for the first time in years, you're going back to the countryside to visit your family. At first, it doesn't seem like there's much to do so far from the city, but you'll soon find there's more to this quiet mountain village than meets the eye!

What worries do your cousins have? Who's the social media sensation taking the small town by storm? What kind of treasure is the mermaid at the beach searching for? And what's up with that weirdo in the gacha mask who's hanging outside the local store?!

Solve all these mysteries and more during one unforgettable summer vacation!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227890]Steam[/url]]
translation:
暑假开始了，这是你多年来第一次回到乡下探望家人。起初，远离城市的地方似乎没什么可做的，但很快你便会发现，这座宁静的山村，远比表面上看起来丰富！

你的表亲们各自藏着什么烦恼？席卷小镇的社交媒体红人是谁？海边的人鱼正在寻找怎样的宝藏？还有，那个戴着扭蛋面具、在当地商店外徘徊的怪人，到底是怎么回事？！

在这个难忘的暑假，解开这些谜团，以及更多未知的秘密吧！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227890]Steam[/url]]
